question: Should omitted Active Memory `config.agents` target every configured agent, falling back to `main`, while explicit `config.agents: []` remains no targets?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes a shipped plugin config/default contract and can alter session memory context for existing installs that omitted the field.

options.title: Approve omitted-agent default with proof
options.body: Land this direction after final-head runtime proof shows omitted config targets configured agents and explicit `[]` remains off.

options.title: Narrow the behavior
options.body: Ask for a smaller fix, such as defaulting only the single-agent `main` setup or repairing setup/doctor/docs instead of changing multi-agent omission semantics.

options.title: Reject the default change
options.body: Keep omission as no targets, close or rework this PR, and direct users to explicit allowlists or `config.agents: []` depending on desired behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve omitted-agent default with proof
recommendation.body: Land this direction after final-head runtime proof shows omitted config targets configured agents and explicit `[]` remains off.
